maddeler.e:
أستحجب (form X)
# أَسْتَحْجِبُ (ʔastaḥjibu) /ʔas.taħ.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# أُسْتَحْجَبُ (ʔustaḥjabu) /ʔus.taħ.d͡ʒa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# أَسْتَحْجِبَ (ʔastaḥjiba) /ʔas.taħ.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# أُسْتَحْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
